I've read the tree and found the next slice, but hit the tool limit before I could write and verify the archive. Here's exactly where I am, so the next run starts from a decision rather than a re-read.

Where the tree actually is
Your memory of this project (in my context) was stale — it said M6 Slice 4. The dump is at commit 88e9bc1, M6 Slice 22 complete: 313 tracked authored files, 996 tests, all 15 §16.3 E2E scenarios passing, docs/_append/ retired, .dockerignore + Containerfile guard landed, F-45 and F-46 written up. Nothing is unmerged.

The next slice, and it was already named
F-44's own row in docs/DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md records something deferred rather than fixed:

"the other four live surfaces publish data-live with no loaded bit and carry the same latent race, passing because their callers go on to wait for specific content… a scenario that fails is the evidence needed for the rest."

That evidence now exists (scenario 10). So the slice is: give the remaining surfaces the data-loaded bit and tighten the four harness barriers.

But the enumeration is wrong, and that's the actual finding. App.razor sets RenderModeForPage => HttpContext.AcceptsInteractiveRouting() ? InteractiveServer : null, so every routable page without [ExcludeFromInteractiveRouting] is interactive. There are six such pages plus one hosted island, not five:

Component	Publishes today
CounterBoard.razor	data-live + data-loaded (Slice 21)
KitchenBoard.razor	data-live only
CounterSitting.razor	data-live only
TableOrderSurface.razor	data-live only
TableDisplay.razor	data-live only, and no _loaded field at all
TableArea.razor (/table)	nothing — no id, no attribute, and it has a "Looking up your tables…" state
Home.razor	nothing, and correctly so — no loading state
That is F-46's shape a third time: a rule enforced as a list of examples, green while narrower than its name. The tree says "the five live surfaces" in five places and /table was never one of them.

Two extra things I verified that shape the fix:

TableDisplay needs a real _loaded, not a rename. Its #table-display-surface element is also rendered by the _qr is null branch, which is reachable transiently between _stage = Live and DescribeCurrentAsync returning — so data-live='true' alone already matches a card with no QR in it.
private bool _loaded; is a clean discriminator. The static-SSR administration pages express loading with null-collection sentinels instead, so the field appears in exactly the interactive set.
What I was about to package (M6 Slice 23, F-47)
Full files, exact paths, extract-at-root .tar.gz, no scripts:

6 Razor files — the four missing data-loaded, TableArea gaining all three, CounterBoard's "five live surfaces" comment corrected
4 harness files — KitchenJourneys, CounterJourneys, TableOrderJourneys, DisplayJourneys: selectors gain [data-loaded='true'], DescribeSurfaceAsync reports it, failure messages name it
NEW tests/MyRestaurant.WebApplication.Tests/Components/LiveSurfaceContractTests.cs — F-38's "name something executable": derives the interactive set from the exclusion attribute rather than a list, and asserts the pair is published and bound to RendererInfo.IsInteractive / _loaded. Repo root found by walking up for MyRestaurant.slnx, mirroring WebApplicationLocator. 6 tests → 1002 total.
